evidence.claim: United Fire Equipments Pvt. Ltd. via updates.lifeguardindia.in outlines their service framework under the LIFEGUARD brand, detailing self-reported offerings that include routine fire safety system inspections, preventive maintenance programs, employee training programs, and structured Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs).

United Fire Equipments Pvt. Ltd. via LinkedIn states that the company operates and utilizes a widespread "network of well settled and flourished dealers all over the country" to market its products and extend its brand goodwill into remote regions of India.

After-Sales Service & Support Infrastruc.assessed_on: We verified the availability of their self-reported maintenance, training, inspection, and nationwide dealer network capabilities. This is not disclosed by the company, so desk research could not confirm objective, third-party data regarding exact service center counts, specific response times, or audited customer satisfaction ratings, placing the company in a tier supported mostly by self-disclosed operations.
